sys_gen_ai_skill.skill_description: This agent specializes in fetching and displaying past travel itineraries for a specified traveller. It can access and read a database of previous itineraries, returning detailed information such as travel dates, ports, airline, cabin class, and business justification. The intended audience includes travel managers, auditors, and travellers seeking a record of their historical trips.
